extracted.name: Chia pudding
extracted.description: Rustle up this simple chia seed pudding for breakfast or dessert. Chia seeds are rich in protein, antioxidants and omega 3, as well as many other nutrients
ingredient_lines: 125ml oat milk or substitute for any nut milk, rice milk or dairy milk
2 tsp maple syrup plus a drizzle to serve
fruit, such as berries, banana, kiwis or mango to serve
instruction_lines: Combine the chia seeds, milk and 2 tsp maple syrup in a jar or bowl. Cover and chill overnight or for at least 8 hrs.
When ready to serve, top with fruit and a drizzle of maple syrup.
